rationale: The core thesis is intact — price still holds above the 9-EMA ($42.71) and VWAP ($42.55), and the drift down from the $42.77 high is occurring on drying volume (2494 rejection, then 877 and 200), which reads as consolidation just under the expected $42.84–$42.87 supply rather than distribution. Risk remains tightly defined: invalidation at $42.69 is ~5 cents below versus ~11 cents of reward to the gap-fill target, so the reward-to-risk still justifies waiting. A flip to short is not warranted because the down-drift lacks volume follow-through against an intraday structure that reclaimed VWAP and is holding near session highs.
